incidents.title: PostgreSQL Service Outage
incidents.impact: Blocking document storage and state persistence across all active agents
incidents.recommended_action: Verify PostgreSQL pod status, check PVC storage disk, restart standby replica

incidents.title: Redis Queue Backlog Overflow
incidents.impact: Async extraction job latency increasing; queue depth > 1000
incidents.recommended_action: Scale Celery worker deployment replicas from 4 to 8

incidents.title: Worker Fleet Capacity Exhausted
incidents.impact: Zero worker processes available to consume incoming document jobs
incidents.recommended_action: Check worker container crash logs and restart worker daemon

incidents.title: Gemini AI Endpoint 503 Outage
incidents.impact: Primary LLM inference failing; degraded mode activated
incidents.recommended_action: Verify Google AI studio status and maintain fallback Claude/vLLM active
